notes.title: Updates to the v1.1 achievements.
notes.content:
'Legendary Duo' achievement was going to be a bit too hard to achieve, so it has been altered to be a lot easier. (P.S I love the theory-crafting in the discussion board!)

Fixed a bug where you would achieve the 'How did this happen?' achievement in the incorrect circumstance.

Fixed an issue where certain events weren't triggering after extended time played.
